hero.subtitle:
We minimize cookies to the absolute essential.

SafeTools uses only standard advertising cookies to keep our tools free for everyone.

sections.title: 1. The Ghost Policy
sections.content: SafeTools does not use tracking cookies for internal analytics or data harvesting. We do not track your session across the web for our own purposes. To us, you are a ghostand that is exactly how it should be.

sections.title: 2. Local Persistence (Storage)
sections.content: We use your browser's LocalStorage only to remember your UI preferences, such as Dark Mode or your recent tool history. This data never leaves your device and is never sent to our servers.

sections.title: 3. Advertising Cookies
sections.content: We use Google AdSense to serve ads. Google may use cookies to serve ads based on your interests. You can manage your preferences or decline these cookies through the consent banner that appears when you first visit our site.

final.subtitle: You don't need to 'Accept' anything here. Your privacy was already accepted by our architecture before you even landed.
